title: Finance and Corporate Services Committee - May 13, 2024

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 2:05 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Asset Management Plans, Non-Core Assets, FIN-2024-208
notes:
The Committee considered the Financial Service Department report FIN-2024-208, dated May 1, 2024 recommending approval of the proposed Asset Management Plans for non-core City asset management plans. 

Brad Wakelin, Manager, Asset Management, presented the report and responded to questions from the Committee. Ryan Hagey, Director, Financial Planning was also in attendance to respond to questions from the Committee. 

Councillor P. Singh entered the meeting at this time.

Councillor A. Owodunni left the meeting at this time.

items.title: Reserve Fund Policy Update, FIN-2024-222
notes:
The Committee considered Financial Service Department report FIN-2024-222, dated May 13, 2024 recommending and amendment to Reserve Fund Policy FIN-RES-770 as well as fund transfers from the Tax Stabilization Reserve Fund to the Investment Stabilization Reserve Fund and the Tax Capital Reserve Fund.

Councillor A. Owodunni re-entered the meeting at this time.

Katie Fischer, Director, Financial Reporting & ERP Sol, presented the report and responded to questions from the Committee.

Councillor P. Singh left the meeting at this time.

motions.item_title: Asset Management Plans, Non-Core Assets, FIN-2024-208
motions.text: it was resolved: "That the Asset Management Plans for the City’s non-core assets as outlined in the Financial Services Department report FIN-2024-208 be approved; and further, That Policy GOV-COR-506 Corporate Asset Management as attached to Report FIN-2024-208 be approved."

motions.text: it was resolved: "That Policy FIN-RES-770 Reserve Funds be amended as identified in the Financial Service Department report FIN-2024-222; and, That funds in the amount of $400,863 be transferred from the Tax Stabilization Reserve Fund to the Investment Stabilization Reserve Fund; and further, That funds in the amount of $4,488,866 be transferred from the Tax Stabilization Reserve Fund to the Tax Capital Reserve Fund."
